purpose: Public-safe market stack matrix for Bionic Banker: job requirement to proof we have to proof missing to next build quest.
privacy_boundary: Public job-market requirements, public-safe proof summaries, and planned build quests only. No private paths, keys, IPs, client data, wallet secrets, or employer internal data.

market_sources.label: State of the Interactive Product Demo 2026
market_sources.signal: B2B websites increasingly use self-guided interactive demo CTAs so visitors can inspect product value without booking first.

market_sources.label: 2026 SaaS and B2B UI patterns
market_sources.signal: Modern AI and SaaS pages use structured dashboards, clear visual hierarchy, product proof visuals, and data views instead of feature soup.

website_scan.current_strength: The site has strong proof content: Projects, Reports, Learn, Gaps, public catalogs, benchmark numbers, and limitations.
website_scan.main_gap: The proof is still mostly read, not explored. A modern technical portfolio should let a visitor interact with a demo, inspect a system map, and see visual proof in the first minute.
website_scan.distance_from_modern_standard: Medium. The foundation is credible and content-rich, but it needs an interactive proof demo, 3D system map, richer charts, and a clearer preview path before it feels like a 2026 AI engineering surface.
next_ui_moves: Create an interactive proof tour that walks through AML Engine, Agent Chess, Heartbeat Lab, Reports, and Build Gaps.
Create a 3D or spatial system map where proof lanes are nodes and evidence links are edges.
Add chart PNG and PDF exports from the report catalog.
Add a local preview guard so file preview does not look broken when root assets are not loaded.
Keep 3D functional: use it to explain system structure, not just as decoration.

gaps.why_market_wants_it: AI teams need systems that retrieve source material, reduce guessing, and show where answers came from.
gaps.proof_we_have: Learning layer explains RAG. Agent Framework Proof v2 includes vector retrieval and citation-shaped proof.
gaps.proof_missing: Public demo showing ingestion, chunking, retrieval, answer generation, citations, and eval score on a small public dataset.
gaps.build_quest: Build a public RAG mini-lab using Bionic Banker articles as the corpus and show retrieval traces.

gaps.why_market_wants_it: RAG and agent memory depend on embeddings, indexing, retrieval speed, and source matching.
gaps.proof_we_have: Concept definition exists. Local agent proof mentions vector retrieval.
gaps.proof_missing: Public comparison of FAISS or Chroma retrieval against keyword search on the same article corpus.
gaps.build_quest: Create a small vector search proof with 20 to 50 public article chunks and a report chart for retrieval hit quality.

gaps.why_market_wants_it: Agent teams need to know what changed, what failed, and whether quality is improving.
gaps.proof_we_have: Agent Framework Proof v2 has test counts. Reports page shows public metrics. Heartbeat Lab shows observable loop status.
gaps.proof_missing: Public eval dashboard with pass/fail cases, judge notes, regression trend, and failure taxonomy.
gaps.build_quest: Add an eval mini-dashboard that scores glossary answers, RAG answers, and AML explanations against expected criteria.

gaps.market_requirement: Agent governance, audit trails, and RBAC
gaps.why_market_wants_it: Regulated workflows need human approval gates, role boundaries, and records of tool use.
gaps.proof_we_have: AI Agent Governance Starter Kit, Agent Chess, audit log concept page, RBAC concept page, and public proof catalog.
gaps.proof_missing: Public interactive scenario showing viewer, reviewer, operator, and admin permissions over the same agent task.
gaps.build_quest: Build a role-permission simulator that shows which actions each role can perform and what gets logged.

gaps.why_market_wants_it: Modern buyers and recruiters want to inspect value quickly instead of only reading claims.
gaps.proof_we_have: Projects, Reports, Learn, and Gaps now form a connected proof route with public-safe JSON catalogs.
gaps.proof_missing: A self-guided demo or tour that shows the system in steps: problem, evidence, live-safe data, limitation, and next build.
gaps.build_quest: Build a clickable Proof Tour page with five scenes: AML Engine, Agent Chess, Heartbeat Lab, Engineering Reports, and Market Gaps.

gaps.why_market_wants_it: Interactive 3D and spatial views are useful when they reveal structure, relationships, and system motion.
gaps.proof_we_have: Homepage already has a particle background and the site has a proof catalog with structured project relationships.
gaps.proof_missing: A functional visual map showing projects, evidence, reports, gaps, and learning concepts as connected nodes.
gaps.build_quest: Build a lightweight proof constellation where each node opens a project, report, concept, or build gap.

gaps.market_requirement: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and service reliability
gaps.why_market_wants_it: Companies want proof that AI systems can be shipped, monitored, rolled back, and run predictably.
gaps.proof_we_have: Public site build pipeline, GitHub-backed proof, and future deployment concepts on Learn.
gaps.proof_missing: Small public service packaged with Docker, Kubernetes manifests, health checks, and a CI workflow.
gaps.build_quest: Build a Kubernetes mini deploy for the proof catalog API or a tiny RAG service, with screenshots and manifests.

gaps.market_requirement: Python backend APIs for AI systems
gaps.why_market_wants_it: Agent and RAG systems need stable API boundaries for tools, retrieval, logging, and frontend integration.
gaps.proof_we_have: Public proof catalogs are machine-readable. Agent Framework Proof v2 shows local workflow proof.
gaps.proof_missing: Public FastAPI service exposing safe endpoints for proof catalog, learning catalog, and report catalog.
gaps.build_quest: Create a public-safe FastAPI wrapper around the catalogs with schema validation and tests.

gaps.why_market_wants_it: Technical reviewers want evidence, numbers, methods, limitations, and repeatable artifacts.
gaps.proof_we_have: Reports page has metric cards, evidence bars, benchmark chart, capability coverage, and notes.
gaps.proof_missing: Downloadable report PDF, methodology section, chart images, and source-linked appendices.
gaps.build_quest: Generate a one-page report PDF and chart PNGs from the report catalog.

gaps.why_market_wants_it: AI builders need to explain systems clearly to users, teams, and buyers.
gaps.proof_we_have: Bionic Banker articles, Learn page, proof console, and report layer.
gaps.proof_missing: Automated draft packets for LinkedIn carousel, X thread, Hashnode article, and GitHub README update from the same catalog.
gaps.build_quest: Create a local content packet generator that turns one concept or report into four public-safe draft formats.
